comment: A third country to the common system of VAT of Directive 2006/112/EC,
article 5(2), which applies only in the territory of the Community as the
Treaties define it. The Gambia levies its own value added tax under the
Income and Value Added Tax Act, 2012, unrelated to the Union's common
system. `vat_prefix` is null: a Gambian taxpayer is identified by the
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) the Gambia Revenue Authority assigns,
which carries no ISO country prefix.
territories.name: The Gambia
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and The Gambia is a third country to it. The Gambia levies a value added tax of its own under the Income and Value Added Tax Act, 2012, administered by the Gambia Revenue Authority, at a standard rate of fifteen per cent (15 %), with a rate of zero per cent (0 %) on exports of goods and services and a list of exempt supplies.
